_about: Round-1 best-in-category picks (UI-HUB, 7 Oct). category -> pick. Install lines are the library's own. 'why' is one line; the full reasoning is in the round-1 page, chapter 4.

overlays/hover-card.why: does all of rule 1: 500 ms rest, 80 ms when warm, focus, Esc, tap to toggle, reduced motion

overlays/notifications.why: the bell: unread badge, All/Unread, mark all read, live summary; rows = our AgentNotificationStack row

overlays/popover.why: click-to-open panel that can hold actions (pinnable pattern = our InfrastructurePopover)

overlays/sheet.why: side sheet for drill-in-place (rule 5); bottom-sheet for touch

navigation/command-palette.why: keyboard-driven, grouped results; compare with our WorkspaceCommandPalette

data-display/timeline.why: newest first, by day, opens in place

data-display/table.why: small tables; dense ones: easyui advanced-data-table; huge ones: Space UI data-grid

data-display/stat.why: an S widget: one number with context

data-display/empty-state.why: a useful next step when there is nothing yet (rule 9)

data-display/avatar.why: one face with a fallback; avatar-group for a row of faces, paired with the hover card

data-display/chat-thread.why: people talking (room chat, team chat): grouped messages, reactions, typing; AI answers use easyui:ai-response

status/skeleton.why: reserve space at real size (rules 9, 10); text-shimmer for 'working'

status/loader.why: calm light across words for ongoing work

inputs/date-picker.why: choose a date without losing context

inputs/period-filter.why: is/before/after/between by day..year: the dashboard filter

ai-agent/run.why: one line per step (thinking, tool call), expand for parameters and output

ai-agent/response.why: the answer: streaming, code blocks, citations, 'used 4 tools' folded

ai-agent/composer.why: try: a collapsed pill that grows into the composer

inputs/tuning-panel.why: internal: tweak a live variant and export the settings
